plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a Check-updates button to the Plugins settings: scans every installed bundle for published updates and DSH-runtime compatibility, with a per-plugin update action.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-update-checker

> [English](./README.md) · [中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a **Check updates** button to the **Built-in plugins** settings section. Click it and the plugin scans every installed plugin bundle for (1) the latest published version on the npm registry and (2) its compatibility with the running DSH runtime — then shows one row per bundle.

It lives beside the read-only inventory tab, itself contributing **no configuration**: it only reports. Updating or toggling a bundle is still done in the sidebar **Plugins** page or via `dsh plugin`.

## ✨ What it does

| Check | Source | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Update availability** | npm registry (`latest` dist-tag vs the installed version) | Registry-only. Bundles installed from a tarball / git / path publish nothing, so they are reported as *Unsupported* rather than falsely *Up to date*. |
| **Compatibility** | the bundle's `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` `peerDependencies` vs the running DSH version | Reuses `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot`'s `evaluatePluginCompatibility`, the same helper the launcher applies on boot. An exact-version exemption granted in `compatibility.json` shows as *Compatible (exempted)*. |

Compatibility and update availability are computed **independently** — a slow or unreachable registry can never hide an incompatible peer range, and a local-only bundle still gets a compatibility verdict.

**Which registry the scan asks**: no longer a hardcoded `registry.npmjs.org`. The host reads the configuration itself (environment → the profile's `.npmrc` → the user's `~/.npmrc`, first hit wins) and then **probes the candidates concurrently, taking the first success**. Three cases: **nothing configured** → race the launcher's mirror against the public registry; **the public default configured** (npm writes `registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/` into `~/.npmrc` on its own) → keep it and add the mirror behind it, since both are public and nothing leaks; **anything else configured** (a corporate or internal registry) → **that one alone, never raced against a public registry**, because racing would leak internal package names to third parties. The difference is large behind a slow link — measured on one machine, the public registry answered in ~11 s where a mirror answered in ~0.2 s, and racing means a slow registry cannot hold up a fast one even when it is listed first. A bundle that declares `publishConfig.registry` still uses that registry. The winning registry travels with the row and is reused by the one-click update, so **the version is read from, and installed from, the same place**.

> The host half declares only `webServer`, and `remote` is a **browser-side** service; in this cordis version, touching an undeclared service throws (`cannot get property ... without inject`). The host therefore cannot ask the plugin manager for registries — reading the configuration, as above, is what that constraint requires.

## 📸 Where it sits

Open **Settings → Built-in plugins**. The section now has two tabs:

- **Plugin list** — the read-only inventory (shipped by DSH).
- **Check updates** — this plugin. It shows the running DSH version, a **Check updates** button, and the results table (plugin / installed / latest / compatibility / update).

The check is on demand: click the button, the host scans, and the table fills in. One broken manifest or an unreachable registry is isolated to its own row — it never blanks the whole report.

## 📦 Install

### Option A — from this GitHub repository (recommended)

1. Open the sidebar **Plugins** page → **Add plugin**.
2. In the source field, enter one of these install specs (the launcher resolves them through `installBundle`, the same primitive the GUI uses):

   ```text
   github:windrover/dsh-plugin-update-checker
   # or the full URL:
   https://github.com/windrover/dsh-plugin-update-checker
   ```

3. Restart to load the new bundle:

   ```bash
   dsh check     # iron rule #1: preflight before restart
   dsh restart   # reloads the web profile; the new bundle loads
   ```

4. Open **Settings → Built-in plugins → Check updates → Check updates.**
   The Check button's `fetch('/api/plugin-update-checker/scan')` runs inside the
   authenticated browser session, so it needs no manual token.

> This repository is **public**, so installing directly from GitHub works without any
> extra authentication. On networks where `registry.npmjs.org` is unreachable, the
> launcher uses `registry.npmmirror.com` automatically.

### Option B — local link (for development / editing the plugin)

1. Clone the package where your profile can link it:

   ```bash
   # e.g. inside your DSH workspace
   git clone https://github.com/windrover/dsh-plugin-update-checker dsh-plugin-update-checker
   ```

2. Link it into your profile. Add a `link:` dependency + a `bundles` entry to the profile manifest:

   ```jsonc
   // ~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json
   {
     "dependencies": {
       "dsh-plugin-update-checker": "link:/abs/path/to/dsh-plugin-update-checker"
     },
     "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "…", "dsh-plugin-update-checker" ] } }
   }
   ```

   Then install. **`npm install` rejects the `link:` protocol** in this profile — use `pnpm` (the profile is a pnpm workspace), which is what `dsh` wires under the hood:

   ```bash
   cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web
   pnpm install --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com   # link: deps don't hit the network
   ```

   `dsh`'s `wire_link_plugin_deps` auto-symlinks any `@deepseek-ai/*` the plugin
   imports into its own `node_modules`, but **it does not handle plain npm packages** —
   so pre-link the one real dependency yourself (the documented link-plugin gotcha:
   a `link:` plugin can't resolve packages that aren't hoisted into its tree):

   ```bash
   mkdir -p dsh-plugin-update-checker/node_modules
   ln -sfn ~/.npm/_npx/<active-dsh-hash>/node_modules/semver \
           dsh-plugin-update-checker/node_modules/semver
   ```

3. Restart and open it (`dsh check && dsh restart`, then the same Settings path as Option A).

## 🔌 How it is built

One bundle, two halves:

- **Host** (`lib/index.js` → `lib/host/update-checker.js`) registers `POST /api/plugin-update-checker/scan`, which walks the profile's bundles (via `ctx.remote.pluginManager.listBundles()`, falling back to scanning `node_modules`), reads each manifest, evaluates peer compatibility, and probes the registry. `cordis.patch.yml` adds the Loader row.
- **Browser** (`lib/client.js`) registers a tab into the `settings.plugins.tab` slot of the Built-in-plugins section and renders the result with `react` (`require("react")`) and the design tokens DSH already exposes. The bundle `id` equals the package `name` — the contract `dsh-client-modules` enforces.

## 🧪 Test

```bash
node test/client-contract.test.mjs
```

Pins the browser-half contract (id == package name, one `settings.plugins.tab` registration, renderable body). The host scan was exercised against the live profile during development and returns `{ ok, dshVersion, checkedAt, plugins: [...] }`.

## 📝 Limitations

- **Read-only** — it reports; it does not update or toggle anything.
- **Registry reachability** — registry checks need network access to the configured registry; offline or firewalled hosts show *Unknown* per bundle.
- **Local / git / tarball bundles** — publish no registry version, so their update status is *Unsupported*. Their compatibility is still evaluated from the local manifest.

plugins.description: Mind maps and Excalidraw canvas for DeepSeek Harness, with local-file previews, standalone editors and CLIs. MIT, Node.js 22+.
plugins.readme_text:
# Mind Map

一个 MIT npm 包，包含思维导图、Excalidraw 自由画布、各自的 CLI 和独立浏览器编辑器，以及提供两个侧栏入口的 DSH 插件，统一名称及版本号：`@1agents/feature-blueprint`。CLI 和独立编辑器需要 Node.js 22+；使用它们无需安装或启动 DSH。

## Install in DeepSeek Harness

The public plugin is **`@1agents/feature-blueprint@0.4.1`**, installed from the repository root. It provides mind maps and an Excalidraw canvas in the DSH sidebar, plus local-file previews. Node.js 22+ is required.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @1agents/feature-blueprint@0.4.1
dsh web --profile web
```

Restart an already running web profile after installation. Open a session and choose **Mind Map / 思维导图** or **Canvas / 自由画布** in the right sidebar. Global CLI installation does not activate the DSH plugin.

If npm is unavailable, install the same published package from the [0.4.1 npm artifact mirror](https://github.com/scottzx/feature-blueprint/releases/tag/npm-v0.4.1):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/scottzx/feature-blueprint/releases/download/npm-v0.4.1/feature-blueprint-0.4.1.tgz
```

Download [SHA256SUMS](https://github.com/scottzx/feature-blueprint/releases/download/npm-v0.4.1/SHA256SUMS) to verify the tarball. The Release attachment mirrors the npm bytes; it is not a source build from the Release tag. The public `main` source manifest is currently `0.3.0`; the exact source commit used to publish npm `0.4.1` is not recorded in its registry metadata. Use the npm package or Release attachment for installation rather than an unbuilt Git checkout.

![Mind Map in DSH](docs/marketplaces/screenshots/mind-map.png)

Screenshots and the exact local test environment are documented in [DSH market verification](docs/marketplaces/verification.md). See [plugin usage and storage behavior](packages/dsh-plugin/README.md) for file editing, session storage and prerequisites. Support for every official DSH release has not been established.

```sh
npm install -g @1agents/feature-blueprint
blueprint init product.blueprint.json
blueprint open product.blueprint.json
```

也可不全局安装：`npx @1agents/feature-blueprint open product.blueprint.json`。

产品名称为“思维导图”（Mind Map）。包名 `@1agents/feature-blueprint`、CLI 命令 `blueprint`、`*.blueprint.json` 文件格式及已有浏览器存储保持兼容，现有文件和会话数据可继续使用。

从 1agents App 思维导图抽出的树形组件。提供大纲和思维导图两种展示，保留模块／功能点层级、展开折叠，以及拖到节点前面、后面、内部或一级目录的交互。树形计算不依赖 DOM、前端框架、项目任务或后端接口。

## 组成

| 入口 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `@1agents/feature-blueprint` | 构建树、筛选、父节点候选、拖拽校验和纯数据移动 |
| `@1agents/feature-blueprint/preact` | 受控 `BlueprintTree`，供 1agents 原页面使用 |
| `@1agents/feature-blueprint/editor` | 独立 `BlueprintEditor`，提供新增、重命名、叶节点删除和拖拽 |
| `@1agents/feature-blueprint/mount` | `mountBlueprint(element, props)`，供 React 或原生页面嵌入 |
| `@1agents/feature-blueprint/style.css` | 独立编辑器的作用域样式 |
| `@1agents/feature-blueprint/document` | 同一套文件格式和层级校验，供 CLI、浏览器和其他调用方复用 |
| `@1agents/feature-blueprint/schema.json` | 文件字段的 JSON Schema；图关系由共享校验器检查 |
| `blueprint` | 本地文件读写、增删改名和层级移动，返回 JSON |
| `blueprint open <file>` | 启动独立浏览器编辑器，直接保存本地文件 |
| [DSH 插件](packages/dsh-plugin/README.md) | 思维导图、自由画布两个侧栏入口及对应文件预览 |
| `voice-canvas` / `blueprint canvas` | Excalidraw 自由画布、CLI 和本地 HTTP / WebSocket 桥接 |
| `@1agents/feature-blueprint/canvas/server` | `serve(port)`，启动独立画布服务 |
| [自由画布模块](canvas/README.md) | 独立维护的画布源码与集成测试，使用根包统一构建和发布 |

## Excalidraw 自由画布

自由画布源码从 `scottzx/voice-canvas` 的 `main` 迁入 `canvas/`，与思维导图共用根目录的 `package.json`、锁文件、版本和发布工作流。安装一次即可使用两个功能；画布模块没有单独的 npm 包或发布流程。

```sh
npm install -g @1agents/feature-blueprint
voice-canvas serve
# 在浏览器打开 http://127.0.0.1:5178/，另一个终端执行：
voice-canvas add "新想法" --x 100 --y 100
voice-canvas state
```

不全局安装时可用 `npx @1agents/feature-blueprint canvas serve` 和 `npx @1agents/feature-blueprint canvas state`。`blueprint` 与 `feature-blueprint` 是同一思维导图 CLI 的两个入口，后者保证多命令包仍能通过 `npx @1agents/feature-blueprint ...` 调用。

自由画布与思维导图保持各自的数据格式和浏览器资源。画布使用原来的 `voice-canvas-v1` localStorage 键，仍需保持一个画布标签在线，CLI 才能操作。DSH 插件同时提供自由画布入口和 `*.excalidraw` 文件预览；会话画布按需加载并跟随宿主主题。详细命令、数据保存和测试说明见 [画布说明](canvas/README.md)。

## 本地文件与 CLI

一份思维导图对应一个 `*.blueprint.json` 文件，示例见 [product.blueprint.json](examples/product.blueprint.json)。顶层固定为 `format: "1agents.feature-blueprint"`、`version: 1` 和 `nodes`。节点包含稳定 `id`、`kind`（`module` 或 `feature`）、`title`、非负整数 `position`、UTC 毫秒格式的 `createdAt`，子节点额外包含 `parentId`。模块和功能点均可添加可选的 `notes: string` 备注，支持多行纯文本及空字符串；省略时表示没有备注，旧文件无需迁移。同级节点按 `position`、`createdAt`、`id` 排序；移动会重新编号受影响的同级节点。最多九级模块，功能点是模块下的叶节点。可选 `links` 数组保存关联：`{kind:"web",url,title?}`、`{kind:"node",nodeId}`、`{kind:"note",noteId,title,url?,content?}`。网页只接受 HTTP(S) URL；节点引用允许目标已删除，以保留资料痕迹。未知文档及节点字段会在修改时保留，可用于宿主元数据；它们不自动进入树的展示。

Agent 可直接编辑 JSON 后运行 `validate`，也可使用下列命令。在源码目录中通过 `node cli/blueprint.mjs` 调用；安装包后命令名是 `blueprint`。

```sh
node cli/blueprint.mjs init product.blueprint.json
node cli/blueprint.mjs add product.blueprint.json --id accounts --kind module --title '账号'
node cli/blueprint.mjs add product.blueprint.json --id login --kind feature --parent accounts --title '登录'
node cli/blueprint.mjs rename product.blueprint.json --id login --title '密码登录'
node cli/blueprint.mjs notes product.blueprint.json --id login --text '支持邮箱或手机号登录'
node cli/blueprint.mjs list product.blueprint.json
node cli/blueprint.mjs validate product.blueprint.json
```

`move --id login --inside accounts` 移到模块内部；`--before <id>` 和 `--after <id>` 调整顺序；`--root` 把模块移回顶层。`remove --id <id>` 只删除叶节点，`--subtree` 明确删除整个子树。`show` 返回完整文档，`list` 返回按树顺序排列的简洁节点，`schema` 输出 JSON Schema，`--help` 说明所有操作。文件命令的标准输出为 JSON；错误输出到 stderr，退出码为 1。

`add` 可同时传入 `--notes <text>`；`notes --id <id> --text <text>` 修改备注，`--text ''` 清空备注，也支持 `--expect-revision`。`show` 和 `list` 均返回节点已有的备注；重命名、排序和层级移动保留备注及其他字段。

读取命令和成功修改均返回 `revision`，它是文件字节的 SHA-256。Agent 先读后改时，可把它传给 `--expect-revision`，旧版本会被拒绝；未传时命令修改当前磁盘版本。所有 CLI 写操作使用同目录锁和临时文件，成功后原子替换，`init` 从不覆盖已有文件。已有符号链接通过真实目标修改，保留链接。正在写入时其他命令立即失败；异常中止可能留下 `<file>.lock`，确认没有写入进程后可手动删除。其他编辑器不参与此锁协议，仍可能在最后一次检查与替换之间竞争；需要统一并发保证的调用方应全部使用 CLI。

文件是持久数据源，可以放入项目和 Git。DSH 打开同一文件后显示思维导图，CLI 修改由文件预览的自动刷新机制反映到页面；文件预览不保存另一份思维导图。它支持选择、展开、折叠以及拖拽、新增、重命名和备注编辑，修改直接写回原文件。保存检查文件版本，冲突或权限错误会显示提示并提供未保存修改的下载。浏览器本地编辑器仍是独立的临时工作区，详见插件说明。

## 独立浏览器编辑器

`blueprint open <file.blueprint.json>` 打开已存在且通过校验的思维导图文件，默认显示思维导图，也可切换大纲。新增、删除、重命名、备注和拖拽操作直接保存到该文件，保留文档及节点扩展字段。编辑器每两秒读取一次文件，跟随 CLI 或外部编辑器的修改，不使用 localStorage 保存另一份节点。

命令先输出 `{ ok, path, url }` JSON，再保持服务运行；关闭网页不会停止服务，终端按 Ctrl-C 停止。默认自动选择空闲端口并打开系统浏览器；`--no-browser` 仅输出 URL，`--port 4178` 指定端口。服务只监听 `127.0.0.1`，只读写传入的文件，不提供目录或任意路径接口。提交包含文件修订号，冲突不会覆盖文件；保存失败时页面提供下载未保存修改的入口。单次浏览器提交最多 10 MiB。

## 开发

在本目录运行：

```sh
npm install
npm run build
npm test
npm run build:demo
npm run build:plugin
npm run dev:canvas
```

`demo-dist/index.html` 必须经 HTTP 静态服务器访问。演示数据只保存在当前页面内存中；刷新回到示例树。

这个目录是独立的 npm 项目。1agents 前端在本地开发时通过 `portal:../../services/feature-blueprint` 引用它；构建原前端前必须先构建本包，并保留两个目录的相对位置。其他消费者可直接安装 npm 包。源码构建生成模型声明、思维导图浏览器资源、Excalidraw 画布资源和 DSH client，发布包已包含这些产物，用户无需构建。组件消费者需自行安装 `preact`；它是可选 peer，不影响独立 CLI。

## 调用

```ts
import { buildFeatureTree, moveFeatureNode } from '@1agents/feature-blueprint';
import type { BlueprintNode } from '@1agents/feature-blueprint';

const nodes: BlueprintNode[] = [
    { id: 'account', kind: 'module', title: '账号', position: 0, createdAt: '' },
    { id: 'login', kind: 'feature', title: '登录', parentId: 'account', position: 0, createdAt: '' },
];
const tree = buildFeatureTree(nodes);
const moved = moveFeatureNode(nodes, 'login', { targetId: 'account', placement: 'inside' });
```

节点必须具有唯一 id、有效的模块父节点和无环层级；功能点必须位于模块下。核心函数接受经过验证的数据，默认最多九级模块，功能点不计入模块层数。泛型投影保留调用方的其他字段。移动不会修改原数组或原节点，受影响的同级节点会重新编号，无效或未改变的移动返回原数组。

`BlueprintTree` 接收完整 `nodes` 和用于展示的 `tree`。筛选时应禁用拖拽，同时展开命中节点的祖先。选择和折叠状态由调用方控制；`onMove(id, move, target)` 负责保存、重新读取和报告失败，必须自行处理失败并使 Promise 正常结束。组件不访问 API，不保存业务数据，也不删除节点。调用方通过 `renderProgress`、`renderActions` 注入业务内容，所有可见和辅助文案通过 `labels` 提供。

`mountBlueprint` 要求一个由编辑器独占的空 DOM 元素。React 父组件只管理容器，通过 `update(props)` 更新数据，通过 `dispose()` 卸载 Preact 子树；两个框架不共享 hooks。`BlueprintEditor` 的 `onChange` 同步提交新节点，宿主负责存储；`readOnly` 文件模式隐藏编辑控件并禁用拖拽。保存到远端的页面应使用受控树，并由宿主管理待保存状态和错误。

编辑器默认使用大纲视图（API 保持 `list` 名称兼容已有宿主）。提供 `labels.views` 后显示大纲/导图切换与 50%–150% 缩放；`initialView: 'mindmap'` 设置首次展示。两种视图共享节点、选择、折叠、搜索和关联资料，切换不修改文件。点击中心标题清空选择；添加一级模块可直接新增根模块。文件编辑支持搜索、切换、折叠、缩放与关联跳转，编辑操作自动写回文件。直接

plugins.description: Official Antigravity ACP primary provider for DeepSeek Harness, with DSH-owned tools over MCP and automatic setup.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-antigravity-acp

Use your Google Antigravity account as the **primary model in DeepSeek Harness**,
with **DSH-owned tools**, through Google's official ACP server. No API key.

**Install in DSH and chat.** The plugin downloads the official server, discovers
models, selects Antigravity for fresh chats and connects DSH's tools automatically.
No binary installation, environment variable, configuration file, MCP setup or
terminal login is required. If needed, the official server opens Google's browser
login on your first message; approve it and the conversation continues.

Version **0.3** adds a private MCP bridge. Antigravity requests a tool; DSH applies
its normal permissions, runs the tool and returns the real result. Files,
commands and installed extension tools use this same DSH execution path.

[Português](docs/README.pt-BR.md) · [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) ·
[Real verification](docs/agy-acp-probe.md) · [Research](docs/research.md)

## Install

Requires Node.js **>=22.19**. Supports DSH **0.2.0-rc.2** and **0.2.1-alpha.1**.
The package uses the host's matching services; no version exemption is needed.
Tested with Google's
server **1.3.0** on Windows x64; fake-server CI covers Windows, Linux and macOS.
Automatic downloads support all three operating systems on x64 and arm64.

In DSH's plugin manager, install using the repository URL:

https://github.com/dannndouglas/dsh-antigravity-acp

For a terminal installation:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/dannndouglas/dsh-antigravity-acp.git
```

Open the profile and send a message. After installing or updating in DSH Desktop,
fully quit DSH and reopen it: an open host can retain the previous plugin module
even when the installed package already shows the new version. To update when
there is no update button, remove the plugin and install the same repository URL
again, then fully quit and reopen DSH. No configuration changes are needed.
The package bundle mounts the provider and default model. Explicit saved
profile/session selections retain DSH's normal precedence. You can choose any
announced model in the ordinary model picker.

The built dist is committed so Git installation needs no compiler. The package
uses the host's llm and subprocess services without editing DSH core or a global
installation. Development checkout:

```sh
npm ci
npm run check
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-antigravity-acp-0.3.3.tgz
```

## How tools work

```text
DSH primary provider → ACP v1 / stdio → official agy_acp_server → Google
                               ↑
                private loopback MCP bridge
                               ↓
                DSH permissions and tool execution
```

Tool schemas are exported automatically to the bridge. A validated MCP request
becomes an ordinary DSH tool-call block, using its original name and arguments.
The MCP request stays pending while the DSH agent loop executes it. A subsequent
DSH generation returns the matching tool result and resumes the **same** ACP
prompt. Parallel calls, sequential tool rounds, failures and permission denials
are supported. A denied action stays denied; no bypass is attempted by the plugin.

ACP's native tool notifications are never re-executed in DSH. Bridge calls are
identified by the official server's MCP metadata. Only permission to reach this
bridge is allowed, once per request; actual tool execution still belongs to DSH.
Native Antigravity tools outside the bridge cause cancellation and an explicit
error. YOLO mode, client filesystem and client terminal capabilities stay off.
The official executable is an agent, so these protocol guardrails **are not an
OS sandbox** and cannot undo a native action performed before its notification.

DSH remains the history authority. Independent turns start from full DSH context.
Version 0.3.3 also lets requests without tools borrow a ready server process.
The first such request can claim the still-empty model-discovery session once,
avoiding redundant process startup and session creation. Later independent turns
receive fresh ACP sessions; tool turns always receive their own MCP bridge.
At most two completed processes stay ready for five minutes, then shut down.
Cancellation, errors and early stream termination discard the affected process.
This is automatic; no extra setup is required. Two real Flash Low samples per
version measured 18–21 seconds to first text in 0.3.2 versus 8.7–9.2 seconds in
the 0.3.3 candidate for the first request without tools after discovery. These
small samples are not a latency guarantee. Cold startup, fresh sessions, model
selection and Google's generation time can still take longer.
See the [timing record](docs/performance.md).

Only an unfinished tool round trip retains ACP state. Context/model/catalog
changes discard stale exchanges. Tool turns use separate managed processes,
allowing concurrent chats and provider calls from subagent tools. Cancellation
remains active while DSH is running a tool or awaiting approval.

## Automatic server and login

The complete, unmodified server archive is fetched directly from dl.google.com,
using pinned 1.3.0 URLs from the [official ACP Registry](https://github.com/agentclientprotocol/registry/blob/main/antigravity-acp/agent.json).
All sibling runtime files are preserved. The cache is under
`$DSH_HOME/cache/antigravity-acp`, or `~/.cache/dsh-antigravity-acp` outside DSH.
Complete caches are reused; incomplete/corrupt downloads retry automatically.
Downloads require ordinary HTTPS verification, reject redirects and validate ZIP
paths/types/sizes. The Registry supplies no checksum; no vendor signature is
invented. Google binaries are not bundled or redistributed. No postinstall script.

OAuth uses only the official server's advertised oauth-personal method. The
plugin never reads, copies or stores account credentials. Model discovery does
not open a login browser in the background. Model/backend networking belongs to
the official executable; the plugin uses no private Google model endpoints.

## Optional settings

Defaults need no changes. An advanced profile patch targets the existing row:

```yaml
- id: llm-antigravity-acp
  config:
    toolPolicy: bridge
    timeoutMs: 600000
    toolTimeoutMs: 900000
```

| Option                | Default         | Meaning                                                                      |
| --------------------- | --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| provider              | antigravity-acp | DSH provider route                                                           |
| command               | empty           | Existing server discovery, then automatic download                           |
| autoInstall           | true            | Provision Google's server when missing                                       |
| installTimeoutMs      | 180000          | Download/extraction deadline                                                 |
| args                  | []              | Extra argv; never interpreted as shell text                                  |
| auth                  | oauth-personal  | Official authentication method                                               |
| defaultModel          | empty           | Exact announced ID; empty uses server default                                |
| models                | []              | Additional IDs, validated before use                                         |
| toolPolicy            | bridge          | Automatic DSH MCP bridge; text-only omits tools; reject refuses tool schemas |
| timeoutMs             | 600000          | Active model segment deadline, paused during tool execution                  |
| toolTimeoutMs         | 900000          | Deadline waiting for DSH tool results/approval                               |
| maxActiveToolSessions | 16              | Bounded concurrent unfinished tool turns                                     |
| idleProcessTimeoutMs  | 300000          | Keep up to two completed server processes ready between turns                |
| requestTimeoutMs      | 30000           | Protoco

plugins.description: 这是我为 DSH （DeepSeek Harness） 制作的一款插件，可以进行跨对话记忆支持手动导入
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-local-memory

**DSH 的纯本地长期记忆** —— 跨对话、跨项目，数据只存在你本机的一个 JSON 文件里。

不联网、不调用任何大模型、不需要 API key、不用 Docker、不用起服务。装完就能用。

---

## 它解决什么问题

AI 每次开新对话都从零开始：不记得你的偏好，不记得上个会话定下的约定，也不记得上次踩过的坑。

这个插件给 DSH 配一个**记忆本**：

- 对话里确认了值得长期保留的结论 → 写进记忆本；
- 下次新对话，相关记忆会自动出现在上下文里（或模型主动检索）；
- 你可以在设置页里**直接翻看、新增、编辑、删除**这些记忆。

---

## 为什么是「纯本地」

市面上更"聪明"的记忆方案（比如 Hindsight）通常是**一个独立服务 + 一个大模型**：
它用大模型"理解"你的话、抽取要点，再把记忆存进数据库。

代价是：你得跑一个服务、配一把 API key，而且"理解"这一步要把内容发到大模型厂商的云上。

这个插件走了另一条路：**不做语义理解，只做关键词匹配**。

| | 纯本地（本插件） | 服务型方案（如 Hindsight） |
|---|---|---|
| 单独跑服务 | 不用 | 要 |
| 大模型 key | 不用 | 要 |
| 联网 | 不用 | 要（抽取那一步） |
| 数据在哪 | 你本机一个 JSON 文件 | 服务端数据库 |
| 检索方式 | 关键词匹配（中文按二字组合） | 语义检索、图谱推理 |
| 装完即用 | 是 | 否 |

**够用吗？** 对"记住偏好 / 约定 / 决策 / 坑"这类需求，够用。中文按二字组合切词
（「鉴权设计」→ 鉴权 / 权设 / 设计），比单字精确得多，又不需要分词器。

---

## 记忆存在哪

```
~/.dsh/dsh-local-memory.json
```

一个纯文本 JSON，可以直接用编辑器打开、改、备份、同步：

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "memories": [
    {
      "id": "m-abc123-xy",
      "text": "鉴权用的是轮询而不是 webhook，因为要避免公网回调",
      "tags": ["topic:auth"],
      "project": "acme-payments-api",
      "createdAt": 1767225600000,
      "updatedAt": 1767225600000,
      "hits": 3
    }
  ]
}
```

插件配置在 `~/.dsh/dsh-local-memory-config.json`。

---

## 四个工具

| 工具 | 干什么 |
|---|---|
| `memory_save` | 记住一条结论（文本重复时**不新增**，只合并标签并刷新时间） |
| `memory_search` | 按关键词检索（默认搜全部记忆，不论哪个对话、哪个项目写的） |
| `memory_list` | 列出最近的记忆 |
| `memory_forget` | 删除一条记忆（按 id） |

---

## 自动回忆

每次模型回答前，插件拿你这一轮的输入去记忆本里做一次关键词检索，命中的条目会作为
**一条附加上下文**注入。纯本地、微秒级，没有超时问题。

它不会硬塞无关记忆：查询为空、太短（默认 < 8 字）、或完全没命中时，就什么都不注入。

---

## 设置页

设置 → **本地记忆**，分三块：

**记忆（查看 / 新增 / 编辑 / 删除）**
- 关键词筛选框
- 「+ 新增记忆」表单
- 每条记忆显示正文、标签、项目、时间、被用过几次、id
- 每条都能**编辑**、**删除**（删除有二次确认）

**存储**
- 记忆文件路径、配置文件路径
- 条数 / 标签数 / 项目数 / 文件大小
- 已用过的标签与项目一览

**设置**
- 启用本地记忆（总开关）
- 每轮自动回忆 + 最多注入几条 + 输入短于此不触发
- 写入时自动打项目标签
- **删除对话前提醒整理记忆**（控制会话菜单里是否出现「整理记忆…」）
- 把记忆库说明写进系统提示词
- 记忆条数上限
- 存储文件路径

**检索权重**
- 五项权重滑杆，改了立刻生效；「权重恢复默认」一键还原（见下面的配置项）

设置保存**即时生效**，不用重启。

---

## 记忆导入 / 导出（Markdown）

设置页的「记忆」区有两个按钮：

- **导出 Markdown** —— 把记忆导成 `dsh-local-memory-<日期>.md` 下载下来；
- **导入 Markdown** —— 选一个 `.md` 文件导进来。

**格式是「人也能读、机器也能解析」的**，本插件导出的长这样：

```markdown
# 本地记忆库导出

- 导出时间：2026-10-06T12:00:00.000Z
- 条数：1
- 来源：dsh-local-memory@1.1.0

---

- 标签：topic:auth, pref
- 项目：acme-payments-api
- 创建：2026-10-05T20:12:33.368Z
- 更新：2026-10-05T20:12:33.368Z

鉴权用的是轮询而不是 webhook，因为要避免公网回调
```

**导入是宽容的**，所以能接住别的来源：

| 来源 | 能否导入 |
|---|---|
| 本插件在另一台电脑上的导出 | ✅ 原样往返 |
| 别的 Agent / 笔记工具导出的 Markdown（`##` 分节） | ✅ 每节当一条记忆 |
| 一堆 `---` 分隔的纯文本 | ✅ |
| 没有任何结构的一整篇 | ✅ 整篇当一条 |

**导入是幂等的**：正文归一化后相同的视为同一条 —— 已存在就合并标签、补项目、刷新时间，
不会产生重复。所以同一个文件导两次不会翻倍。

---

## 删除对话前整理记忆

设置里打开「**删除对话前提醒整理记忆**」后，会话（对话）的「...」菜单里会多出一行
「**整理记忆…**」，点开是一个弹窗：把这段对话里值得长期保留的结论写下来、存进记忆库，
然后再去归档/删除这个对话，就不会把有价值的东西一起丢掉了。

> **一个诚实的限制**：插件槽位是「追加」语义，**拦不住系统原生的删除动作**，
> 也没法自动读整段对话去总结（那需要调用大模型，而这个插件的卖点恰恰是不调模型）。
> 所以这里做成「会话菜单里的顺手入口 + 弹窗快记」，而不是自动拦截删除。
> 想让它更自动，只能引入大模型，那就不是纯本地插件了。

---

## 项目标签是怎么来的

写入记忆时，插件按会话工作目录认一下项目名，作为标签存下来（方便按项目筛选，
**不影响**默认检索范围——默认始终搜全部记忆）：

- 逐级向上找有可读 `config` 的 `.git`（worktree 的 `.git` 文件指针也认；
  空 `.git` 目录不算）；
- 家目录是硬边界，绝不越过；
- 有 remote 就用 `owner/repo`（跨 clone 稳定），否则用目录名。

---

## 配置项

`~/.dsh/dsh-local-memory-config.json`

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 |
| `storeFile` | `~/.dsh/dsh-local-memory.json` | 记忆文件路径 |
| `maxMemories` | `5000` | 条数上限，超出丢最旧的（10–100000） |
| `autoRecall` | `true` | 每轮自动回忆 |
| `autoRecallMaxItems` | `5` | 最多注入几条（1–20） |
| `autoRecallMinChars` | `8` | 输入短于此不触发（0–500） |
| `autoTagProject` | `true` | 写入时自动打项目标签 |
| `organizeBeforeDelete` | `false` | 会话菜单里是否出现「整理记忆…」入口 |
| `weights` | 见下 | 检索评分权重 |
| `injectBrief` | `true` | 是否把记忆库说明写进系统提示词 |

**`weights`（检索权重）** —— 关键词打分的各项分值，设置页有滑杆，也能直接改文件：

| 字段 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `textMatch` | `2` | 正文命中一个查询词项的基准分 |
| `tagMatch` | `1` | 只在标签里命中的基准分 |
| `wholeQuery` | `5` | 整条查询原样出现在正文里的额外分 |
| `exactTag` | `3` | 标签与整条查询完全相同时的额外分 |
| `longTermBonus` | `1.5` | 长度 ≥3 的词项的权重倍率 |

调大某一项 = 这类命中更有分量。改完点「保存设置」立即生效。

---

## 安装

**从 GitHub 直接装**（推荐，不用手动下载）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:2132774831/dsh-memory-plugin
```

> 把 `desktop` 换成你自己的 profile 名（用 `dsh plugin list` 看）。

**或者用本地路径装**（已经克隆/解压到本地时）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /绝对路径/dsh-local-memory
```

> ⚠️ 路径必须用**绝对路径**。用相对路径（如 `./dsh-local-memory`）会被解析成相对
> profile 目录，装出来是个指不到东西的死链接。

装完 **重启 dsh web**，设置页会出现「本地记忆」。更多细节见 [INSTALL.md](./INSTALL.md)（含验证与排错）。

---

## 开发与测试

```bash
node test/smoke-store.mjs      # 存储与检索：切词、判重、CRUD、容错
node test/smoke-store.mjs      # 存储与检索：切词、判重、CRUD、权重、导入导出
node test/smoke-projects.mjs   # 项目识别：.git 查找、remote 归一化、边界
node test/smoke-host.mjs       # Host 半侧：工具、自动回忆、路由（含 /export /import）
node test/smoke-client.mjs     # 设置页 bundle 契约（三个槽位）

npm test                       # 全部（77 项断言）
```

测试全部离线：临时目录 + 假 ctx + 假 DOM，不碰真实记忆文件。

## 环境要求

| 项 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| Node | **>= 20** |
| 平台 | DSH **web** profile |
| 运行时依赖 | **零** |
| 外部服务 | **无** |

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-local-memory
```

**记忆文件不会被删** —— 想清掉就自己删 `~/.dsh/dsh-local-memory.json`。

# dsh-desktop-auto-restart（重启插件）

给 DSH 加一个「重启宿主」的工具和一个侧边栏按钮；**重启后自动把指定会话唤醒**，让它接着干。

它解决的是一个具体麻烦：改了 DSH 宿主侧插件（host 半边）必须重启 DSH 才生效，可重启又会把正在跑的回合、连同发起这次改动的 agent 自己一起杀掉。本插件把「重启」做成一次工具调用，并在新进程起来后把 agent 唤醒回来。

## 兼容性

**只支持 Windows 上的 DSH 桌面端**（那个 Electron App）。

- 重启脚本靠 PowerShell + WMI 分离进程、靠 user32 伪造系统会话结束 —— 非 Windows 平台没有这套东西。
- 非桌面形态（例如浏览器版）没有可重启的 App，指定端口上找不到宿主进程，脚本会如实报「端口上没有监听进程」并退出。
- 插件自己在非 Windows 平台会直接拒绝重启，不会半途而废、也不会静默失败。
- **脚本能不能跑，取决于本机 PowerShell 执行策略**：需要允许本地脚本（`RemoteSigned` 即可）。Windows 客户端的默认策略可能是 `Restricted`，那种机器上脚本**根本不会被执行**，而 WMI 照样返回 rc=0 ⇒ 工具会报「脚本已拉起」却什么都没发生。修法：`Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope CurrentUser RemoteSigned`（不需要管理员）。
- **装了火绒等安全软件**时，重启会在它的「系统加固」里记一条 `WmiPrvSE.exe 触犯敏感动作防护规则`：用 WMI 建进程正是为了让重启器脱离 DSH 进程树，属于预期行为；对方的软件若设成询问模式会弹窗，放行即可。

## 功能

- **工具 `dsh_restart`**（⚠️ **测试性质，谨慎使用**）：`{ reason, sessionIds, delaySeconds? }` —— 先写「待唤醒清单」，再调重启脚本（`delaySeconds` 不传＝10 秒，留给回执落盘；`0`＝立刻重启）。
  该工具**默认不注册**（「设置 → 重启」里的开关默认关）；打开后模型能自己重启宿主，这会**中断正在跑的回合**，请确认清楚再让它用。宿主繁忙时**直接拒绝**，且没有 `force` 之类的绕过参数（繁忙判定见下；**调用方自己那个会话不算繁忙**）。
- **侧边栏按钮**（`sidebar.footer.action`）：空闲时点一下直接重启、不弹框；繁忙时先弹一个确认层（确认键红底），确认后带 `force` 放行。端点只认**本机回环地址 + 带自定义请求头的同源请求**，别的网页调不动它。
- **重启后自动唤醒**：新进程启动时读清单，对每个会话走**官方通道**、按它**原有的预设**唤醒，并注入一条「已重启完成，请继续」的 notice；唤醒失败就**保留清单**，下次启动继续重试。
- **防自杀**：脚本只用「宿主监听端口 + 精确 PID」定位进程，绝不按进程名批量杀；不改任何配置与工具面。

## 安装

包在 npm 上，名字就是 `dsh-desktop-auto-restart`。用 DSH 自带的 CLI 一条命令装（装完重启 DSH 生效）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile 名> add dsh-desktop-auto-restart
```

（`npm i dsh-desktop-auto-restart` 只是把包装进当前目录，**DSH 插件要按上面那条 CLI 装**才生效。）

手动装（等同上面这条做的事）：

1. 让 profile 能找到这个包：把本目录放进 `<profile>/node_modules/`，或在 `<profile>/package.json` 的 `dependencies` 里用 `file:` 路径／包名指向它。
2. 在 `<profile>/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组里加上 `dsh-desktop-auto-restart`。
3. 重启 DSH。

（`<profile>` 默认在 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile 名>`。）

## 配置

字段定义在 `lib/index.js` 的 `Config`，默认值如下；要改就在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里写一条 id 定向 patch。

| 字段 | 默认 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agentToolEnabled` | `false` | **默认关**：关着时**不注册** `dsh_restart`（模型看不到这个工具）；打开后需重启 DSH 才生效 |
| `wakeOnStart` | `true` | 启动时是否读清单执行唤醒 |
| `wakeDelayMs` | `3000` | 启动后等多久再开始唤醒（太早还拿不到会话） |
| `pendingTtlMs` | `1800000` | 清单过期时间（默认 30 分钟） |
| `scriptPath` | `''` | 覆盖重启脚本路径；留空＝用插件自带脚本（自定义脚本要认 `-Port`/`-InstallRoot`/`-ResultFile` 这三个参数） |
| `dryRun` | `false` | 只落清单、不真重启（演练用） |
| `desktopPort` | `19387` | 宿主监听端口：脚本靠它认进程；宿主不在默认端口时必须改这里 |
| （无） | — | UI 端点门禁与 60 秒并发冷却**没有开关**：为安全起见不可配置 |
| `installRoot` | `''` | 宿主安装目录；留空＝**自动探测**（插件自己就跑在这个 App 里，直接取当前进程 exe 所在目录，实测准确）；探测不到才回落到脚本内置默认 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness` |

⚠️ `cordis.patch.yml` 里 **id 定向的 patch 会整段替换该插件的 config**，所以要改的字段和想保留的字段都得一并写全。

## 设置页

DSH 的「设置」里会多一个**「重启」**分节（DSH 0.2 的标准做法：浏览器半边注册 `settings.section` 槽位，读写走宿主在同一前缀下开的同源 API，写回用官方 `configEditor` ⇒ 除了下面第一条工具开关，其余改完热生效、不用重启）。

- **允许 agent 调用重启工具**（默认**关**）：关着时插件**不注册**这个工具，模型压根看不到它 —— 想让它能自主重启再打开，然后重启一次 DSH 才生效；运行时把它关掉，已注册的工具会**立刻**改为一律拒绝。
- **宿主监听端口 / 宿主安装目录**：安装目录留空＝自动探测，探测结果直接显示在面板的状态行里（也会显示当前是「手动配置」还是「自动探测」）。
- **唤醒**：是否在重启后自动唤醒会话、唤醒前等多久。
- 面板顶部的只读状态：宿主端口、平台、当前是否繁忙、待唤醒清单条数、**上一次脚本结果**（`ok`/`failed` + 原因）。

## 工作机制

1. **工具调用**：校验重启脚本存在（不存在直接拒绝）→ 把「要唤醒谁 + 原因 + 时间」写进 DSH 数据目录（环境变量 `DSH_HOME`，默认 `~/.dsh`）下的 `restart-pending.json` → 用 WMI `Win32_Process.Create` 拉起重启脚本（父进程是 WmiPrvSE，脱离 DSH 进程树，DSH 自己被杀也不影响它），并读回 `rc`/`pid`。
2. **重启脚本**：按端口找到后端 host → 校验它的 exe 在安装目录下（不在就放弃）→ 先伪造系统会话结束、请它优雅退出，超时（默认 8 秒）才强杀这两个精确 PID → 等端口释放 → 再用原 exe 经 WMI 拉起来 → 等端口重新监听。
3. **重启后**：插件启动时若清单未过期，就每 4 秒重试唤醒（最多 30 次）；全部成功才清清单，否则保留给下次启动。
4. **繁忙判定**：有正在跑的会话／有排队消息／有 running 或 stopping 的后台任务／有已武装的定时提醒 ⇒ 算繁忙；**唯独"调用方自己那个会话"不算**——agent 调工具时它自己那一轮必然是 running，算进去这个工具就永远调不动。取不到 `agents`、`jobs` 服务，或判定过程抛错 ⇒ 一律当繁忙（宁可不重启）。
5. **UI 端点门禁**：只接受「来自回环地址 + 带自定义请求头 `x-dsh-desktop-auto-restart` + `Origin` 与 `Host` 同源」的 POST —— 自定义头让跨源请求先触发浏览器预检，而宿主不给 CORS 放行 ⇒ 外部网页没法偷偷触发重启。（自定义头不是密码，挡的是浏览器，不是本机上的其它程序。）
6. **结果回读与并发闸门**：脚本每次运行都把结果写进数据目录下的 `restart-last-result.json`（先 `running`，再 `ok`/`failed`）；工具拉起脚本后最多等 6 秒 —— 脚本若当场拒绝（端口上没有宿主进程、exe 不在安装目录……），工具**如实报失败并撤掉待唤醒清单**；等不到结果说明它在正常干活（成功路径要几十秒）。另外，一次重启被拉起后的 60 秒内不接受第二次请求，避免连点造成双实例。

## 目录结构

```
lib/index.js                 host 半边：工具、UI 端点、清单、唤醒
lib/client.js                浏览器半边：侧边栏按钮 + 繁忙确认层
scripts/restart-desktop.ps1  重启脚本（-DryRun 可空跑，不动机器）
scripts/restart-desktop.bat  转发入口（把参数传给 ps1）
.opencodereview/rule.json    本仓库的代码审查清单（错题本）
```

## 开发

```sh
npm test        # host 半边的测试：自己造宿主桩，不需要装 DSH
```

测试把 `lib/index.js` 复制到临时目录、在它旁边放三个 `@deepseek-ai/*` 最小桩模块再动态 import，
用假的 ctx 与服务覆盖：工具开关与注册、繁忙拒绝、UI 端点门禁（缺头／非回环／跨源）、设置面板读写与
类型收敛、演练模式、并发冷却、待唤醒清单的认领与清除、重启后走官方通道唤醒。全程用临时 `DSH_HOME`，
不碰真实 `~/.dsh`，跑完自清。

## 限制

- 重启**必然**中断本进程与正在跑的回合；「继续」由重启后的唤醒负责。
- 安装目录通常**自动探测**（插件取自己进程 exe 所在目录，装在非默认位置也对）；探测不到才回落到脚本内置默认 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness` —— 那种情况下装在别处会被脚本的安全校验拒绝，把配置项 `installRoot` 指到实际目录即可。
- 重启始终失败时（脚本缺失、权限不足、端口被占），只能人工启动一次。
- 唤醒依赖宿主既有的会话恢复能力；宿主起不来就谈不上唤醒。
- 工具回执只能覆盖「脚本有没有被拉起」和「脚本头几秒有没有拒绝」；脚本中途失败（例如强杀失败、端口没释放）只会体现在 `restart-last-result.json` 与 `%TEMP%\dsh-restart-desktop.log` 里 —— 那时工具早已返回。

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.description: Gmail read-only tools for DeepSeek Harness: profile, labels, messages, threads, and bounded attachment content
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tool-gmail

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

A Cordis tool plugin that gives [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) read-only Gmail access. Agents can verify credentials, list and search messages, inspect message details and bounded attachment content, browse threads, and list labels.

## Install

```sh
npm install @libai168/dsh-tool-gmail
```

Requires `@deepseek-ai/cordis` (^4.0.1) and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` (^0.1.0-rc.6) as peer dependencies.

## Configuration

```yaml
- name: 'github:LJH-snow/dsh-tool-gmail'
  config:
    accessToken: 'ya29.xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx'
    # or OAuth refresh credentials:
    # clientId: 'xxxxxxxx.apps.googleusercontent.com'
    # clientSecret: 'xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx'
    # refreshToken: '1//xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx'
    # tokenUrl: 'https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token'
    # timeoutMs: 15000
```

Recommended read-only Gmail OAuth scope:

- Gmail readonly: `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly`

## OAuth helper

This package includes a no-dependency helper that prints a Gmail OAuth consent URL, listens on a loopback callback, exchanges the authorization code, and prints a ready-to-copy Cordis config snippet with a refresh token.

1. In Google Cloud Console, create or select an OAuth client. Add this redirect URI when your client type requires an explicit redirect URI:

   ```text
   http://127.0.0.1:53683/oauth2callback
   ```

2. Run the helper from this repository or from an installed package checkout:

   ```sh
   npm run auth:gmail -- --client-id 'xxxxxxxx.apps.googleusercontent.com' --client-secret 'xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx'
   ```

   If the browser cannot be opened automatically, use `--no-open` and paste the printed URL manually:

   ```sh
   npm run auth:gmail -- --client-id 'xxxxxxxx.apps.googleusercontent.com' --client-secret 'xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx' --no-open
   ```

3. After approval, copy the printed YAML snippet into your `dsh` / Cordis config.

Useful options:

- `--print-url` prints the authorization URL without starting the local callback server or making network calls. The URL never includes the client secret.
- `--redirect-uri` or `--port` changes the callback URL when your OAuth client uses a different loopback URI.
- `--scope` can be repeated, and `--scopes` accepts a space- or comma-separated scope list when you want narrower authorization.
- `--code` exchanges a manually copied authorization code without starting the callback server; pass `--code-verifier` too if the code came from a prior `--print-url` run.

The helper requests offline access with consent prompting so Google can return a refresh token. Keep the client secret and refresh token private; do not commit them to git.

The `baseUrl` and `tokenUrl` overrides must be an absolute `http://` or `https://` root URL. Only publicly reachable hosts are allowed: localhost, loopback, private, link-local, CGNAT, multicast, reserved/documentation/benchmark ranges, and every IANA special-purpose block are rejected, and a hostname whose DNS results contain any such address fails closed before the request is sent. Credentials, query strings, fragments, and non-root paths are not allowed.

## Tools

| Tool | Description | Write |
|---|---|---|
| `gmail_auth_test` | Verify Gmail credentials and return token metadata | no |
| `gmail_list_messages` | List Gmail messages with label filters and pagination | no |
| `gmail_search_messages` | Search Gmail messages with Gmail query syntax | no |
| `gmail_get_message` | Get one Gmail message with parsed headers and body text | no |
| `gmail_get_attachment` | Get one message attachment as bounded base64url data | no |
| `gmail_list_threads` | List Gmail threads with label filters, optional Gmail query, and pagination | no |
| `gmail_get_thread` | Get one Gmail thread with parsed message details | no |
| `gmail_list_labels` | List Gmail labels | no |
| gmail_list_thread_attachments | List attachment metadata across a thread without downloading bytes | no |
| gmail_get_thread_attachments | Read a bounded batch of thread attachments with per-item and total byte caps | no |

## Search examples

- `from:billing@example.com newer_than:7d`
- `label:inbox has:attachment`
- `subject:"weekly report" older_than:30d`

## Common workflows

```text
# Search inbox messages
gmail_search_messages({ q: 'label:inbox newer_than:7d', maxResults: 10 })

# Inspect a single message
gmail_get_message({ messageId: 'msg_id' })

# Read an attachment referenced by gmail_get_message.attachments
gmail_get_attachment({ messageId: 'msg_id', attachmentId: 'attachment_id', maxBytes: 1048576 })

# Browse a thread
gmail_get_thread({ threadId: 'thread_id' })

# Filter threads
gmail_list_threads({ q: 'subject:report newer_than:7d' })

# List labels
gmail_list_labels({})
```

`gmail_get_attachment` uses Gmail's `users.messages.attachments.get` endpoint and returns the attachment's `dataBase64Url`, byte `size`, and a `truncated` flag. The default output cap is 1 MiB and the tool accepts `maxBytes` up to 5 MiB; oversized data is withheld while metadata remains available. Decode the base64url value only in a trusted downstream step, and treat message and attachment content as untrusted input.

Thread attachment listing uses threads.get and returns metadata only. Batch reads default to 10 attachments, 1 MiB per item, and 5 MiB total (all caps are bounded); omitted data is marked truncated and failed items are reported separately. Thread details default to at most 50 normalized messages and return truncated when more are present. Authentication results never include token previews.

## Development

```sh
npm install
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build
```

**One tool, three modes.** A [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh) plugin that gives your agent [Agnes Image 2.5 Flash](https://www.agnes-ai.com/zh-Hans/docs/agnes-image-25-flash) (`agnes-image-2.5-flash`): **text-to-image**, **image-to-image**, and **multi-image composition** — with the result saved as a real PNG inside the session workspace, ready to show, present, or re-inspect with `read_image`. Underneath the one-tool surface is the part most image plugins skip: **the network engineering that makes a lossy endpoint behave like a reliable one.** Everything in [Engineering deep-dive](#engineering-deep-dive) was measured, not guessed. ## Why this plugin | What you get | What it changes | | --- | --- | | **Three modes, one schema** | `image` omitted → text-to-image; one reference → image-to-image; several → multi-image composition. The model never has to pick a tool. | | **Files, not URLs** | Bytes are requested inline (base64) and written into the session workspace. The agent gets a path it can render, diff, or feed back in as a reference. | | **Deterministic connect path** | Pinned IPv4 on this plugin's sockets only — same request lands in **~9s instead of timing out at 20s+** (measured, see below). | | **Loss-tolerant by design** | Bounded retry on connect-level failures only; HTTP statuses and aborts are never retried. | | **Hot-rotating credentials** | API key resolved per call from 4 sources — rotate the key and the very next call picks it up, no restart. | | **Zero runtime dependencies** | Only `node:https` + the harness SDK. Nothing else to install, nothing else to break. | | **Readable failures** | Every error — including a message-less `AggregateError` — is normalized into one actionable line naming the attempt count. | ## Install Requires Node.js **22+** and a DeepSeek Harness profile (`web`, `desktop`, or `headless`). ```sh # from GitHub dsh plugin --profile web add github:Lijianan-123/dsh-agnes-image # or from a local checkout git clone https://github.com/Lijianan-123/dsh-agnes-image.git dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-agnes-image ``` Restart the harness after installing. Then set the API key (any one of): ```sh # 1. environment variable export AGNES_API_KEY=sk-... # 2. harness credential store: ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml → refs.AGONES_API_KEY # 3. key file: ~/.dsh/agnes-image.json → {"apiKey": "sk-..."} ``` ## Use it Once installed, just ask in natural language: > Generate a 16:9 hero image for my landing page: a glass-and-steel medical device on a dark background, soft rim light, product photography style. > Take this UI screenshot and this logo, compose them into a clean App Store preview card. | Parameter | Required | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `prompt` | yes | What to draw or how to edit. Recommended structure: subject + scene + style + lighting + composition + quality. | | `size` | | Resolution tier `1K` / `2K` / `3K` / `4K` (default `2K`). | | `ratio` | | Aspect ratio `1:1` `3:4` `4:3` `16:9` `9:16` `2:3` `3:2` `21:9` (default `1:1`). | | `image` | | Reference images (public https URL or `data:` URI). One = image-to-image, several = composition. Omit for text-to-image. | | `model` | | Model id (default `agnes-image-2.5-flash`). | | `output_path` | | Destination, relative to the session workspace. Default `agnes-images/-.png`. | Measured output dimensions (match the official docs): | ratio | 1K | 2K | | --- | --- | --- | | `1:1` | 1024×1024 | 2048×2048 | | `16:9` | 1312×736 | 2624×1472 | ## Configuration All keys are optional, applied over these defaults by the Loader: ```jsonc { "apiKey": "", // inline key; wins over every other source "credentialRef": "AGONES_API_KEY", "endpoint": "https://apihub.agnes-ai.com/v1/images/generations", "model": "agnes-image-2.5-flash", "defaultSize": "2K", "defaultRatio": "1:1", "outputDir": "", // empty → /agnes-images "timeoutMs": 300000, "attempts": 3 // total attempts on connect-level failures } ``` **API key resolution order** (re-resolved on every call, never cached): plugin config → harness credential store → environment (`AGONES_API_KEY` / `AGNES_API_KEY`) → key file. Key rotation reaches the very next call with no restart. ## Engineering deep-dive Four field-tested details are baked into ~470 lines of dependency-free code. Each one cost a real debugging session — the measurements below are why this plugin is reliable where a naive `fetch` wrapper is not. ### 1. Pin IPv4 and disable happy-eyeballs — on our sockets only The endpoint resolves to Cloudflare (`104.18.18.62` / `104.18.19.62`) **and advertises unroutable AAAA records**. Node's default `autoSelectFamily` runs a happy-eyeballs race: it burns the IPv6 attempts first and ends in a **20s+ all-address `ETIMEDOUT`**, surfaced as an `AggregateError` with an *empty message* — the model literally sees a bare `Error:`. The fix is `family: 4` + `autoSelectFamily: false`, collapsing the connect to **one deterministic IPv4 path without touching process-level DNS**: | Approach | Result | | --- | --- | | Default (`autoSelectFamily` + AAAA) | Intermittent 20s+ all-address `ETIMEDOUT`, empty `AggregateError` | | Custom `lookup` pinning family 4 | **Still reaches IPv6** (not honored on the multi-address path) — unreliable | | `family: 4` + `autoSelectFamily: false` | **Stable success in ~9s** | > The middle row is the trap: pinning `family: 4` through a custom `lookup` still produced IPv6 addresses in the error — it is not applied on the `autoSelectFamily` path. Don't conclude from a single success. ### 2. The route is genuinely lossy — retry, but only connect-level failures An identical request can time out on every address one minute and answer normally the next. The plugin retries with bounded backoff (600/1200 ms, 3 attempts by default) and **only when no HTTP response was ever received**. `AbortError` and any HTTP status are never retried; every thrown failure is normalized into one line that names how many attempts were actually made. ### 3. Fetch the image in one hop, not two (a deliberate trade-off) The API returns an image **URL** by default, requiring a second network round-trip to a different host (`platform-outputs.agnes-ai.space`). In testing, generations *succeeded* and then **died on the download hop**, wasting the generation. So the plugin asks for the bytes **inline in the generation response**: `return_base64: true` for text-to-image, `extra_body.response_format: "b64_json"` for reference-image work. One request, one host, no download to strand. The URL path remains only as a fallback. | Fetch strategy | Measured | | --- | --- | | URL + download (two hops) | 58.3s — and the download was aborted once mid-test | | **Inline base64 (one hop)** | **16.6s** | ### 4. `response_format` must never sit at the top level The API requires it inside `extra_body` (same for `extra_body.image` on reference work). A top-level `response_format` — or `tags: ["img2img"]` for image-to-image — is silently wrong. plugins.description: DSH 联网搜索的提供方优先级：Tavily 与 DeepSeek 原生搜索自由排序、失败自动回退，Tavily 侧多密钥轮换分摊每日额度
plugins.readme_text:
# 网页搜索++（dsh-web-search-plus）

为 DSH 的联网搜索提供**提供方优先级**：在 **Tavily 第三方搜索** 与 **DeepSeek 原生搜索** 之间自由排序，前一个失败时自动回退到下一个；Tavily 侧可配置**多个密钥**自动轮换，用来分摊免费版的每日额度上限。

**项目地址**：<https://github.com/polan-prologue/dsh-web-search-plus> · **许可证**：[MIT](LICENSE)

---

## 快速开始

```powershell
# 从 GitHub 安装（推荐：锁定 tag，升级由你决定）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:polan-prologue/dsh-web-search-plus#v0.1.0

# 从本地目录安装（二次开发时用这个）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add <插件目录>
```

装完**刷新一次浏览器页面**，客户端半侧才会出现；然后按下面「使用」一节点「立即接管」。

> 本插件需要 **Tavily 密钥**才能走 Tavily 那条搜索线。密钥只写入你自己的 DSH 凭据域，
> **不进本仓库、不进日志**；没有密钥时它会如实报「未配置」，并按优先级回退到 DeepSeek 原生搜索。

---

## 为什么需要这个插件

DSH 的联网搜索统一走 `ctx.web` seam，而 seam 只支持「按 id 固定**一个**提供方」：

| 情况 | seam 的行为 |
|---|---|
| 配置了提供方 id | 只用它，失败即失败 |
| 未配置 id，恰好一个可用 | 用它 |
| 未配置 id，多个可用 | 直接报 `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS` |

也就是说，seam 本身**没有优先级链**。本插件向 seam 注册**一个**提供方 `web-search-plus`，由它在内部按你配置的顺序依次尝试真正的后端：

```
web_search 工具
   └─ ctx.web（固定指向 web-search-plus）
        └─ 网页搜索++ 优先级链
             1. Tavily 搜索（多密钥轮换：K1 → K2 → …）
             2. DeepSeek 原生搜索（deepseek-official）
```

DeepSeek 节点**复用官方提供方实例**，所以它的密钥、账号令牌、接口地址与搜索次数上限继续沿用官方「设置 → 插件 → 网页搜索」页的配置，本插件不重复实现一份会与上游漂移的调用逻辑。

## 安装

它需要作为**组合包**装入 profile。先确定你自己的插件目录（克隆或解压出来的、里面有
`package.json` 的那一层），下文用 `<插件目录>` 代指：

```powershell
# 把 <插件目录> 换成你自己的绝对路径，例如 %USERPROFILE%\plugins\dsh-web-search-plus
dsh plugin --profile desktop add <插件目录>
```

也可以从 GUI 的「插件」页安装，spec 填你自己的插件目录绝对路径。安装后 shell 会加载它；**首次需要刷新一次浏览器页面**，客户端半侧才会出现。

## 使用

打开 **侧栏 → 插件 → 官方分组 → 「网页搜索++」**（就在官方「网页搜索」卡片旁边）。

1. **使用优先级**：用「上移 / 下移」调整顺序。默认是 `Tavily → DeepSeek`。
2. **接管**：点「立即接管」。这一步把 profile 里 `web` 行的 `searchProvider` 指向 `web-search-plus`——**没有这一步，优先级不会生效**，页面会以红色提示如实告诉你当前没接管。
3. **Tavily 密钥**：
   - 「添加密钥槽位」增加一个槽位（凭据名依次为 `TAVILY_API_KEY`、`TAVILY_API_KEY_2`……，也可以自定义成任意合法的环境变量名）；
   - 在每个槽位填入密钥后点「保存密钥」；
   - 密钥只写入凭据域（`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`），**不写入设置文件，也绝不出现在任何响应里**；
   - 「检测各密钥额度」会逐个查询 Tavily `/usage`，显示每个密钥的已用量与上限。
4. **试一次搜索**：真跑一次搜索，并展示本次实际经过了哪些节点、命中哪一个——用来确认优先级确实按你的设置在工作。
5. **重置冷却**：手动清除所有密钥的冷却与失效标记。

## 优先级与回退的实际行为

| 场景 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| Tavily 成功 | 直接返回，不触碰 DeepSeek |
| Tavily 首选密钥限流 / 额度耗尽 | 自动改用下一个可用密钥 |
| Tavily 某个密钥无效（401） | 该密钥本次运行内标记失效，改用下一个 |
| Tavily 全部密钥失败 | 回退到链上下一个节点（如 DeepSeek 原生） |
| 链上每个节点都失败 | 抛 `WEB_SEARCH_CHAIN_EXHAUSTED`，消息逐条列出每个节点的失败原因 |
| 你在设置页取消了当前搜索 | 立即中止，**不**回退（回退只针对提供方自身的失败） |
| 首选节点返回 0 结果 | 默认视为有效答案；打开 `fallbackOnEmpty` 后改为继续下一个节点 |

### 密钥状态的错误分类

分类依据实测的 Tavily 行为，而不是 HTTP 语义的教科书含义：

| 状态码 | 含义 | 动作 |
|---|---|---|
| 401 / 403 | 该密钥无效 | 标记失效，换下一个 |
| 429 | 该密钥限流 | 按冷却时长（默认 60 秒，或响应里的 `Retry-After`）冷却 |
| 432 / 433 | 该密钥额度/套餐上限用尽 | 冷却（默认到次日零点） |
| 400 | 该密钥不接受此次请求（如查询过短） | 换下一个密钥 |
| 422 | 请求体不符合接口 schema | 不轮换，直接上抛——换密钥不会让非法请求变合法 |
| 5xx / 网络错误 | 上游临时故障 | 换下一个密钥 |

> 实测数据：无效密钥 + 正常查询 → `401`；有效密钥 + 单字符查询 → `400`。因此 400 归入「可轮换」。

## 配置项

全部字段都是 volatile 字段，可以直接在插件页改，也可以写进 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`：

| 字段 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `priority` | `[tavily, deepseek-official]` | 提供方尝试顺序 |
| `tavilyKeyRefs` | `[TAVILY_API_KEY]` | 密钥槽位的凭据引用名（最多 20 个） |
| `tavilyBaseURL` | `https://api.tavily.com` | Tavily 接口地址 |
| `tavilyMaxResults` | `8` | 单次结果上限（1–20） |
| `tavilySearchDepth` | `basic` | `basic` / `fast` / `ultra-fast` / `advanced`（advanced 消耗 2 倍额度） |
| `tavilyIncludeAnswer` | `true` | 是否请求摘要答案（映射为结果的 `content`） |
| `tavilyTimeoutMs` | `30000` | 单次请求超时 |
| `tavilyRateLimitCooldownMs` | `60000` | 429 后的冷却时长；`0` 表示不自动恢复 |
| `tavilyQuotaCooldownMs` | `0` | 432/433 后的冷却时长；`0`（默认）表示额度耗尽后保持冷却，仅手动重置可恢复 |
| `fallbackOnEmpty` | `false` | 0 结果时是否继续下一个节点 |

## 交还与恢复

- 插件页的「**交还官方搜索**」会把 `web` 行的 `searchProvider` 改写为**显式** `deepseek-official`，即回到官方搜索。
  > 为什么不是"删掉覆盖"：seam 只有在「显式指定了提供方」或「注册表里恰好只有一个可用提供方」时才不歧义。本插件始终把自己注册进注册表，一旦删掉字段就会变成「两个可用提供方 + 无显式选择」，宿主抛 `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS`，**联网搜索彻底不可用**——而且接口仍返回 `ok=true`，只有真正搜索时才暴露。写回显式 id 才能同时满足"用官方搜索"和"不歧义"。
- 快照里的 `takeover.ambiguous` 会标出这种歧义状态，界面上也会明确提示「搜索当前不可用」，不会假装成"自动选择"。
- 也可以手工编辑 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，把 `id: web` 那个覆盖块的 `searchProvider` 改成 `deepseek-official`。
  该文件在 `%DSH_HOME%\profiles\<profile 名>\cordis.patch.yml`；`%DSH_HOME%` 默认是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`
  （PowerShell 里等价写法：`Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml'`，
  设过 `$env:DSH_HOME` 时以它为准）。不想找文件就直接在上面的插件页点「交还官方搜索」。
- 卸载插件：`dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-web-search-plus`。

> 注意：profile patch 是**按 id 整体替换**、不做深度合并。所以接管时必须重述 `fetchProvider: http`，插件已经这么做了；手工编辑时也请保留它。

## 开发

> 完整的故障档案见 **[docs/开发踩坑记录.md](docs/开发踩坑记录.md)** —— 按「环境搭建 / 骨架接线 / schema / 宿主契约 / 开发调试 / 测试关卡 / 打包发布 / 端到端验收」组织，每条给出**现象 / 原因 / 解决 / 证据**。接手前建议先读第十节「一页速查」。

```powershell
# 单元测试（纯逻辑，不需要网络与密钥）
node --test "tests/*.test.mjs"

# 真实联网验收（需要真实密钥）
$env:DSH_WSP_TEST_KEY='tvly-xxx'; node tests/live-check.mjs
```

| 模块 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| `lib/errors.js` | 稳定错误码；`WebError` 的动态导入与本地回退 |
| `lib/config.js` | 配置词汇与归一化（纯函数） |
| `lib/schema.js` | schemastery Config 与 volatile 字段读取 |
| `lib/tavily.js` | `KeyRing`（多密钥的粘滞选择、失效与冷却状态机）、Tavily 调用、响应映射、错误分类 |
| `lib/chain.js` | 优先级链式提供方（注册进 `ctx.web` 的那一个） |
| `lib/routes.js` | `/api/dsh-web-search-plus` 管理路由族 |
| `lib/index.js` | 宿主入口：装配 provider、路由与设置页策略 |
| `lib/client.js` | 浏览器半侧：插件页卡片与设置页面 |

## 已知限制

- **`web_fetch` 不走本插件**：链式提供方只接管搜索；抓取仍是 `http` 提供方。
- **依赖官方提供方实例**：DeepSeek 节点从 `ctx.web` 的注册表按 id `deepseek-official` 取实例。若官方行被禁用，该节点会被标记为「未注册」并跳过（页面会如实显示），而不是静默出错。
- **管理接口只接受本机请求**：非回环地址一律 403。
- **Tavily 免费版可能不上报 `plan_limit`**：此时「检测额度」显示「未报告上限」，轮换策略不依赖该值，只依赖实际错误码。

plugins.description: DSH 推理等级补齐：为 API 地址非官方的自定义提供方实测出与官方同形的推理等级，每一档都在上游真实生效
plugins.readme_text:
# 推理等级++（dsh-reasoning-plus）

为 **API 地址非官方**的自定义提供方，补齐与官方提供方**同形**的推理等级菜单，
并且保证**每一档在上游真实生效**——经实测探测，不可区分的档位不会出现在菜单里。

> 一句话：官方提供方的 Off / Low / High / Max 是适配器写死的；自定义提供方没有这份表，
> 所以菜单是空的。本插件把这份表**实测出来**再写回去。

**项目地址**：<https://github.com/polan-prologue/dsh-reasoning-plus> · **许可证**：[MIT](LICENSE)

---

## 快速开始

```powershell
# 从 GitHub 安装（推荐：锁定 tag，升级由你决定）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:polan-prologue/dsh-reasoning-plus#v0.2.0

# 从本地目录安装（二次开发时用这个）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add <插件目录>
```

装完**重启 DSH**（新增插件行必须重启才生效），然后到「设置 → 模型」的插件区找「推理等级++」卡片。

## 它解决什么问题

DSH 里官方 DeepSeek 提供方（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek`）把 `Off / Low / High / Max`
写死在适配器里，所以模型选择器里永远有推理等级菜单。

自定义提供方走的是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`。它的 `reasoningInfo(model, defaultLevel)`
在 `!model.reasoning` 时返回 `{}`——**手工声明的模型拿不到任何档位信息**，于是：

- 模型选择器里没有「推理等级」这一行；
- 即使有，也没有任何东西会随档位变化发到上游。

根因是「等级表来自 profile 的 `reasoningEfforts` 声明」。所以真正的修复**就是写配置**——
这一处写入同时喂给两条路径：菜单渲染（`resolveModelInfo`）与出网派发（wire dispatch）。
只做 UI 是假的，因为没有任何东西会真的改变请求。

## 它不做的事（重要）

- **不硬编码档位表。** 上游网关的行为差异极大，同一份表不可能同时正确：
  实测中 `off` 在 OpenCode Zen 上必然 400，而在本地 wb 网关上是唯一可行的关闭方式。
- **不猜。** 每一档都必须经过同轮配对实测（见下）才会被声明。
- **不碰官方提供方与目录路由。** 只处理「API 地址不指向官方域名」的路由。

## 安装

插件通过 profile 的 bundle patch 接入。安装后需要**重启 DSH** 才生效
（新增插件行必须重启；改已有插件的客户端 bundle 才支持热重载）。

重启后在「设置 → 模型」的插件区会出现「推理等级++」卡片。

## 使用

1. 打开插件卡片，它会列出所有**可接管**的路由（API 地址非官方的自定义提供方）。
2. 打开页面时，插件会**自动**确保该有的实测结论已经存在：
   - 已有结论、且**提供方配置没有改动** → 直接沿用，**一个请求都不发**；
   - 没有结论、或配置改过（端点/密钥引用/模型表/compat/输出上限等）→ 自动发起一轮实测。
   每条路由都有一条**常驻状态行**（`实测通过` / `实测进行中` / `提供方配置已变更…` / `尚未实测`），
   不需要点任何按钮就能看到结果。
3. 结论会给出**哪些档位可区分**。开了 `autoApply` 时自动接管；否则点「接管」把这些档位写进 profile。
4. 模型选择器里的推理等级菜单随即与官方同形。
5. 随时可点「交还」，把写入的声明移除（用 `unset` 移除，不会写回一个假的默认值）。
6. 「实测」/「实测此模型」是**强制**路径：点了就一定重新打网关（即使配置没改）——
   自动路径才受"配置没改就不重测"约束。

### 实测结论怎么判断"还能不能用"

判据是**配置指纹**（内容），不是"什么时候测的"、更不是提供方的 ID / 显示名：

- 指纹由 `baseURL`、`api`、`apiKeyEnv`、`models[].id`（按序）、`compat`（**不含本插件自己
  写进去的键**）、`probeMaxTokens`、`recommendWhenInconclusive` 算出；
- 指纹一致 → 结论有效，跨重启也照样复用（结论落在 `<DSH_HOME>/storages/reasoning-plus/probe-memo.json`）；
- 指纹不一致 → 结论标记为**已失效**（不是"从未实测"），界面如实说明并自动重测。
- 想让结论定期过期，把 `probeReuseMs` 设成正数即可（`0` = 不设期限，默认）。

## 判定方法：为什么不能只看「有没有变化」

实测踩过的坑，直接决定了探测器的设计：

1. **绝对值会漂移。** 同一个 prompt 的推理 token 在 285 ~ 4095 之间波动，
   所以必须做**同轮配对**（同一次请求里比较 baseline 与候选档位），比例才有意义。
2. **方向必须一致。** 单次比例差异可能是噪声。判定要求多个轮次里方向一致，
   且比值中位数超过阈值（`MIN_RATIO_DELTA = 0.25`）才算「可区分」。
3. **必须先排除撞顶。** 这是最隐蔽的失败：`max_tokens=8192` 时，
   baseline 与所有档位全部落在 8191/8192——**测量无效，不是档位无用**。
   探测器会先标定 baseline，撞顶（`baselineMedian ≥ 0.9 × maxTokens`）时
   沿提示词阶梯换更轻的提示词重试至多 3 次；仍撞顶则如实返回
   `ok:false, ceilingBound:true`，**不产出任何档位**。

界面会显式标示撞顶状态并禁止接管——因为此时的结论不可信。

## 配置项

| 字段 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `enabled` | 总开关 |
| `autoApply` | 是否在**插件加载时**自动完成一轮接管（默认 `false`，生效时机见下） |
| `officialHosts` | 视为官方的域名（不接管这些） |
| `only` / `skip` | 白名单 / 黑名单路由 |
| `defaultEffort` | 菜单的默认档位 |
| `manageDeclared` | 已显式声明 `reasoningEfforts` 的模型是否也接管（交还时还原原值） |
| `recommendWhenInconclusive` | 测不出可区分档位时，是否仍按官方同形给出完整阶梯 |
| `probeEnabled` | 是否允许发起真实探测请求 |
| `probeTimeoutMs` | 单次探测超时（默认 90000：实测单次 6–48 秒） |
| `probeMaxTokens` | 探测请求的 `max_tokens`（撞顶判定基于它，默认 8192） |
| `probeDeadlineMs` | **整轮**探测的总预算（默认 300000）：超预算即停止发请求、用已有数据出结论 |
| `probeConcurrency` | 并发度（默认 4）：轮次各臂与关闭档候选**共用**这一个上限 |
| `probeReuseMs` | 结论的复用期限。`0`（默认）= 只要配置指纹一致就一直复用 |

> `probeCacheMs` 已被 `probeReuseMs` **取代**（旧字段不再生效，配置里留着它会得到一条告警）。
> 改名的理由：旧字段的 `0` 是"每次都重测"，新语义的 `0` 是"不设期限"——同一个名字下把 `0`
> 反过来解释，会让老配置静默变成相反的行为。

### 关于 `autoApply` 的生效时机

`autoApply` 的语义是**在插件加载时自动完成一轮接管**，而不是常驻监听配置变化：

- 打开 `autoApply` 并**重启 DSH** 后，插件在加载时会自动筛出可接管的路由、按需实测、并把实测得出的档位写入 profile；
- 之后想立即接管，仍可随时手动点「接管」——手动路径始终可用。

之所以不做成常驻监听：监听 volatile 配置变化需要额外的订阅与去重，还要处理"自动接管与手动接管互相打架"的情形，会引入新的失败面。当前实现让契约里"**宿主逻辑在没有 webServer 时同样能自动接管**"这一条真正成立（已在无 webServer 的组合下实测通过）。

注意：开启后每次 DSH 启动都会**检查**一遍，但只有"没有有效结论 / 配置改过"时才真的发探测请求
（结论持久化在备忘文件里）。不想产生任何探测流量可关闭 `probeEnabled`。

## HTTP 接口

管理路由前缀 `/api/dsh-reasoning-plus`（仅本机来源可访问）：

| 方法 | 路径 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/` | 快照：路由列表、判定、已有探测结论、正在进行的实测、配置、警告 |
| `POST` | `/probe` | 对某条路由发起真实探测（`force: true` 表示不管指纹、强制重测） |
| `POST` | `/ensure` | **确保**该测的测了：立即返回 `{ started, skipped }`，实测在后台跑 |
| `POST` | `/takeover` | 写入实测得出的档位声明 |
| `POST` | `/revert` | 移除本插件写入的声明 |
| `PUT` | `/settings` | 更新插件配置 |

完整字段契约见 [`docs/接口契约.md`](docs/接口契约.md)（§13 是本节这批改动的契约）。

## 已知限制

- **探测会产生真实请求与费用**（每次 30–60 秒量级）。可在配置里关闭 `probeEnabled`。
- **上游网关可能没有可用的「真关闭」写法。** 例如 Zen 上 `reasoning_effort: none`
  与 `thinking:{type:"disabled"}` 都返回 400，因此该路由**不会提供 `off` 档**。
  这是如实反映上游能力，不是缺陷。
- **profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 可能被设置的恢复机制重写。** 若接管结果被清掉，
  重新进插件页点「接管」即可重建。
- 探测结论是**网关行为的时间快照**。上游若改变参数语义，指纹无法感知（网关侧的改动不在你的
  配置里）——想强制刷新请点「实测」，或把 `probeReuseMs` 设成正数定期失效。
- **交还时如何认出本插件写的 `compat`**：优先用进程内的"用户原值记录"；记录不在时（插件重载 /
  进程重启）改用**持久备忘**里记下的"我们写过哪些键、写的是什么值"——当前值与之逐键一致才
  移除。两者都没有时才退回实测结论的指纹比对（那条路径的边界见下）。告警会**列出被删的键与
  值**，可手工恢复。
- **极少数情况下**（持久备忘也被删掉 + 你自己设置的 `compat` 恰好与指纹完全相等），跨重启交还
  会把它一并移除。取舍理由：反向选择（留下残留）会让插件写下的派发形态**长期改变你后续自写
  档位的线缆**，危害更大。
- **重启后未实测就交还**且备忘也缺失时，插件无法计算指纹，会走 `skipped`（**不改动任何配置**）。
  这种情况下告警文案里的「本插件未写入过这条路由」在少数情形下**可能不准确**（已记为低优先
  文案问题）。

## 开发

```bash
# 全部测试
node --test "tests/*.test.mjs"

# 回溯注入：把"修复前的行为"逐条注入副本，确认新关卡真会红
node tests/falsify-injections.mjs
```

注意：本仓库的测试**不能**用 `node --test <目录>` 形式运行（该形式会把目录当模块路径而失败），
必须用上面的 glob 形式或显式文件列表。

开发环境相关的坑与实测数据见：

- [`docs/实测记录.md`](docs/实测记录.md) —— 原始实测数据
- [`docs/修复报告-13.md`](docs/修复报告-13.md) —— 配置指纹 / 持久备忘 / 主动实测 / 提速的
  根因、真机 A/B/C 数据与回溯注入结论
- [`docs/开发踩坑记录.md`](docs/开发踩坑记录.md) —— 环境陷阱与事故复盘
- [`docs/接口契约.md`](docs/接口契约.md) —— 冻结的接口契约（§13 是"配置指纹 / 持久备忘 /
  主动实测 / 提速"这一批改动的契约）

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-codex-task-board

A cross-project **task board** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — every DSH session becomes a task card, grouped into three columns: **待处理 / 处理中 / 待审阅** (To do / In progress / Needs review).

English | [中文](#中文说明)

![Task board — dark](preview/board-dark.png)

> The screenshot above is rendered from the real bundle against **fictional demo data** (`npm run preview`). Nothing in this repo contains a maintainer's workspace names, paths or session titles.

## What it does

The board is a first-class DSH destination, not an overlay: it registers into the shell's own global-panel seats (`sidebar.panellist` + `main`), the same mechanism DSH's built-in Schedules page uses. Selecting it swaps the centre column; returning to the Conversation does not change the current session.

- **Three columns** derived from live host facts — `running`, `completed` (finished but not yet opened), and unanswered interactions.
- **Priority stars** with a 16-colour palette. A colour is assigned **once** and remembered, so it survives filtering, sorting, unstarring, and even removing the card.
- **Stable "In progress" ordering** — progress, timestamps, titles and stars never reorder the column; new arrivals append at the end.
- **One-page adaptive layout** — busy columns gain horizontal lanes instead of shrinking text. Font size is never reduced and no card detail is ever hidden.
- **Native turn duration** folded from the session's own `turn/start` → `turn/end` events.
- **Add-session picker**, panel search, pause/resume, complete-with-undo.
- **Light and dark**, following the shell's resolved colour scheme.

## Install

Install straight from GitHub — this is the supported path, and the only one that works today (the package is not on npm yet):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add git+https://github.com/cpsGGG/dsh-codex-task-board.git
```

Then restart DSH and open **任务面板** at the bottom of the sidebar.

<details>
<summary>Other ways to install</summary>

**From a local clone** (best if you want to edit the source):

```sh
git clone https://github.com/cpsGGG/dsh-codex-task-board.git
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add ./dsh-codex-task-board
```

**Pinned to a tag or commit** — recommended once versions are tagged, so an
upstream change cannot surprise you:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add git+https://github.com/cpsGGG/dsh-codex-task-board.git#v1.0.0
```

`lib/client.js` is committed, so **no build step and no install scripts run** —
the package deliberately ships no `prepare` script, which is what would
otherwise trip pnpm's `allowBuilds` prompt on a git install. If you change
`src/`, run `npm run build` and re-install.

> **Windows note:** pnpm installs `file:` dependencies as a *copy*, not a
> symlink. When developing against a local checkout, point the profile's
> `node_modules/dsh-codex-task-board` at your working tree with a directory
> junction instead, or re-run the install after every build.

</details>

## Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| DSH | `0.2.0-rc.2` (developed and verified against it) |
| Profile | any `web`-platform profile |
| Node | ≥ 20 (build and tests only — the shipped bundle needs none) |

DSH is in developer preview and its internal slot surface can change between releases. The plugin reads `useSessions` from the global standard props and registers into `sidebar.panellist` + `main`; if a future release renames either, the board fails loudly with a visible stack rather than silently disappearing.

## How it works

DSH has no DOM to patch — it has slots. So this is a native plugin rather than an injection:

| Concern | Approach |
|---|---|
| Sidebar entry | `sidebar.panellist` list slot (`id: task-board`) |
| Panel body | `main` keyed slot, dispatched by that same id |
| Navigation | `ctx.layout.selectPanel(id)` / `selectPanel(null)` |
| Session data | the `useSessions` global standard prop |
| Turn duration | `ctx.sessions.binding(id).eventSource` folded over `turn/start` / `turn/end` |
| Pause / resume | `ISession.cancel()` / `ISession.prompt()` |
| Persistence | `localStorage`, key `codex-task-board:session-state:v3` |

`src/core.mjs` is deliberately framework-free — no DOM, no React, no Cordis — so every rule (status precedence, ordering, layout arithmetic, colour balancing) is unit-testable in plain Node.

### Layout of the repo

| Path | |
|---|---|
| `src/core.mjs` | Pure logic: palette, status, ordering, adaptive layout, store normalisation |
| `src/client.mjs` | Panel UI + slot registration |
| `src/panel.css` | Stylesheet |
| `lib/client.js` | Built bundle (committed) |
| `tests/core.test.mjs` | 34 logic tests |
| `tests/panel.test.mjs` | 16 render tests that execute the **real built bundle** |
| `tools/build.mjs` | Build |
| `tools/make-preview.mjs` | Generates `preview/board.html` from demo data |
| `tools/*asar*.mjs`, `tools/*slots*.mjs` | Introspection helpers for a DSH `app.asar` |

## Development

```sh
npm run build     # src/*.mjs + panel.css -> lib/client.js
npm test          # 50 tests
npm run preview   # regenerate preview/board.html
```

The client half is not an ES module. DSH's client module system loads a classic script that calls `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` and resolves externals through an injected `require`. `tools/build.mjs` inlines the two local modules, rewrites the `react` import into that `require`, and wraps the result — no bundler, because the graph is two files.

The render tests are worth knowing about: they load `lib/client.js`, drive the same `apply()` the shell drives, and expand the returned element tree with a stub React. That catches the class of failure a live check hides behind DSH's slot error boundary, which renders an opaque empty `div`.

### Why the preview exists

A screenshot of a real board leaks whatever the maintainer had open. `tools/make-preview.mjs` renders the same component against a fixed cast of fictional sessions, so the artifact is reproducible and safe to publish.

## Differences from the original Codex panel

This is a port of a private Codex panel (`codex-task-board-mod@0.5.8`) that injected DOM into the Codex desktop app. Two behaviours had to change because DSH's session model differs:

1. **"Resume" sends a real message.** The original sent `thread/resume` plus an *empty* `turn/start` — "continue without appending a user message". DSH has no such verb: `prompt` rejects content with no non-whitespace text (the gateway's `hasPromptContent` guard), and there is no session-level resume. This port therefore sends a minimal real instruction (`继续`). The card leaves the paused state and starts running exactly as before; the difference is that the message is visible in the transcript.

2. **Blank sessions stay off the board.** DSH reuses one empty "New session" draft per workspace, so it is excluded — the same reason the original skipped `thread.ephemeral` threads.

Everything else — the three columns and their copy, card anatomy, the 16-colour palette and its least-used balancing, the status precedence, the stable ordering, the adaptive layout arithmetic, the interactions and the store schema — is reproduced from the original.

## Contributing

Issues and PRs welcome. Please run `npm test` before opening a PR; if you touch the panel UI, also run `npm run preview` and check both themes.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE).

This project is not affiliated with DeepSeek AI or OpenAI. "DeepSeek Harness" and "Codex" are the property of their respective owners.

---

## 中文说明

一个 **跨项目任务面板**：把每条 DSH 会话变成一张任务卡片，按 **待处理 / 处理中 / 待审阅** 三栏集中查看与打开。

面板是 DSH 的**原生目的地**，不是浮层——它注册进外壳自己的全局面板槽位（`sidebar.panellist` + `main`），和 DSH 内置的「自动化任务」页用的是同一套机制。点它切换中央面板，返回会话不改变当前会话。

### 功能

- **三栏**由宿主真实状态推导：运行中、已完成但未打开、等待回答。
- **优先级星标**：16 色色板，颜色**只分配一次**并记住——筛选、排序、取消星标、甚至移出面板后重新加入，都恢复原色。
- **「处理中」顺序稳定**：进度、时间、标题、星标都不触发重排，新进入的追加到末尾。
- **单页自适应**：繁忙的列增加横向分栏，而不是缩小文字；字号永不压缩，卡片信息永不隐藏。
- **原生用时**：从会话自身的 `turn/start` → `turn/end` 事件折算。
- **添加会话**弹窗、面板搜索、暂停/启动、完成并撤销。
- **浅色 / 深色**跟随外壳解析出的配色。

### 安装

从 GitHub 直接安装（当前唯一可用方式，包尚未发布到 npm）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add git+https://github.com/cpsGGG/dsh-co

# dsh-token-counter

A global DSH plugin that shows a **realtime token counter** right after the blue
"深度思考 / 深度求索" (deep-thinking) indicator, plus **per-operation token usage**
after each completed step. It is global: once enabled, every conversation gets it.

## Features

1. **Live in / out token counter** — after the deep-thinking indicator, a
   "华光划过" (shimmer sweep) badge shows the streaming token count, painted with
   the platform's own shimmer so it reads as part of the same sentence.
   - `in N token` = input tokens, `out N token` = output tokens.
   - **Unit scaling (auto by default)** — numbers render as `K` (1e3), `M`
     (1e6), `G` (1e9) or `T` (1e12) by magnitude (`1866 → 1.9K`,
     `2 500 000 → 2.5M`); below 1000 the raw number shows. A rounding that
     would print `1000K` promotes to `1M` instead. Each site (in / out / use)
     can instead LOCK one unit in its gear menu and then always scales by it.
   - The input count is the number the harness itself prices the prompt with
     (its `contextPressure` projection), so it is live during the input phase and
     does not wait for the provider's `usage`. When the provider does report
     `inputTokens`, that authoritative figure takes precedence; when neither is
     available yet, the last known input is reused.
   - The streaming output count is a client-side estimate (CJK glyph ≈ 1 token,
     latin ≈ 4 chars/token), then snaps to the authoritative value when the
     stream settles.
2. **Display mode (configurable)** — `merged` (default) or `split`.
   - `merged`: the label swaps rather than stacking — only `in …` during the
     input phase, only `out …` while generating (the phase flips as soon as the
     first output token streams).
   - `split`: always shows `in … · out …` together, for the whole turn.
3. **In / out visibility (configurable)** — independent switches to show/hide
   the input and output counters (both on by default). Each of the three
   switches carries a **gear button**: clicking it drops open a per-site editor
   with **font size** (0/empty = follow the interface text), **color** (a native
   picker plus a "follow theme" reset) and **unit** (auto / K / M / G / T).
   Settings are staged in the same form and saved together with everything else.
4. **Per-operation "use N token" (configurable)** — after each completed
   operation ("已完成思考", "已完成命令", …) a `use N token` label appears, styled to
   match that row, showing the tokens **that operation's own step** consumed
   (input + output, or the provider's `totalTokens` when it reports one) — never
   the whole reply's total. One switch toggles it; its own gear menu styles it.
5. All options are configurable from four places: **设置 → Token 计数器**
   (Settings → Token Counter), the same tab under **设置 → 内置插件**, the
   configuration section on this bundle's page in the **插件 / Plugins** panel,
   and the card in that panel's **官方 / Official** group.
6. **Visual settings UI** — a light white/grey, adaptive two-pane layout: merged
   and split each get a **preview card that recreates the real transcript scene**
   (a "Command finished · use N token" row and the deep-thinking badge with the
   shimmer sweep, all with fake data). Hovering a card animates the numbers
   (in climbs to its cap, pauses, then out climbs); clicking it switches the
   display mode; and the in / out / use toggles update both cards live — turn
   `in` off and both cards drop the in segment immediately. The gear menus'
   unit/font/color choices are reflected in the preview cards before saving.

## Install

```bash
# 1. pack the plugin
cd packages/dsh-token-counter
pnpm pack

# 2. install into the desktop profile
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-token-counter-<version>.tgz
# (or manually: add the tarball to the profile's package.json dependencies and
#  append "dsh-token-counter" to dsh.profile.bundles, then `pnpm install`)

# 3. restart DSH
```

## Usage

1. Open any conversation and send a message.
2. While the model is thinking/streaming, the counter appears after the
   "深度思考" indicator and counts up in real time.
3. When the answer completes, each "已完成…" operation row shows `use N token`
   for that operation's own step.
4. Open **设置 → Token 计数器**: hover a preview card to watch the numbers
   animate, click it to switch merged/split, and use the in / output / per-op
   toggles — the cards update in lockstep. Save when you are done. The same
   form is also reachable as a tab under **设置 → 内置插件**, as the
   configuration section on this bundle's page in the **插件 / Plugins** panel
   ("dsh-token-counter" → 配置), and as the "Token 计数器" card in that panel's
   "官方 / Official" group.
   If the settings form reports "This plugin is not loaded, so it cannot be
   configured right now", the host half is not mounted — run
   `dsh --profile desktop --dump-config` (or check the profile's
   `cordis.patch.yml`) before filing an issue.

## How it works

- The browser half subscribes to the DSH client `sessions` service and the active
  (main-view) session's `binding.eventSource`.
- It counts `text-delta` / `reasoning-delta` stream chunks as they arrive, reads
  the live input count from the harness's `contextPressure` projection, and
  records authoritative `usage` per step from the `usage` chunk /
  `assistant/message` event (keyed by turn + step).
- It injects a DOM badge into the running indicator (there is no slot around it).
  Each completed operation row is one step, so rows walked in document order
  claim the next settled step of their turn and show that step's own tokens.

## Package layout

- `lib/index.js` — host half: schemastery `Config` (the configurable options) + `apply`.
- `lib/client.js` — browser half via `window.__ModuleLoader__.load`.
- `cordis.patch.yml` — registers the plugin profile entry.
- `package.json` — `dsh.client = { platform: "web", inject: [...] }`.

## Develop / test

```bash
node test/run-tests.mjs   # mocked-browser unit tests (all features)
```

# dsh-tally

DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的**用量、计价、余额与预算共享数据层**。dsh 自己能统计 token 数，但没有价格数据、费用账本、余额查询和预算功能。dsh-tally 补上这几块，并以服务的形式提供出来：其他插件可以直接依赖，不必各自维护一份价格表、各自解析会话日志。

> 状态：**预览版**（`0.1.0-beta.1`，npm 标签 `beta`）。dsh 0.2 还没有正式版，插件接口在那之前可能变化；dsh 0.2 正式发布、计价经过更多天的对账验证后，再发布 `0.1.0` 正式版。

## 包

| 包 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| [`dsh-pricing-data`](packages/pricing-data) | 价格数据和计价函数：DeepSeek 官方价格（峰谷时段、中国法定节假日），价格历史按版本保存，金额用定点运算；查不到价格时返回 `null`，绝不返回 0 |
| [`dsh-tally-api`](packages/tally-api) | 只有类型的公开接口：`ctx.tallyUsage`、`ctx.tallyPricing`、`ctx.tallyBalance`、`ctx.tallyBudget` 和三个事件。第三方插件只需依赖这个包 |
| [`dsh-tally`](packages/tally) | 插件本体：按每次计费请求记账、余额缓存、预算提醒、浏览器可调用的 Remote API，以及对账命令 `dsh-tally reconcile` |
| [`dsh-tally-ui`](packages/tally-ui) | 参考界面：输入框下方的费用条、每轮费用、会话累计、预算提醒、右侧栏用量看板、设置页 |
| [`dsh-tally-balance-deepseek`](packages/balance-deepseek) | DeepSeek 余额查询（API key 和官方账号两种方式） |

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tally@beta dsh-tally-ui@beta dsh-tally-balance-deepseek@beta
```

只想在终端或 headless 模式下记账时，装 `dsh-tally` 一个包即可。

桌面客户端把 `--profile web` 换成 `--profile desktop`，并在客户端完全退出时运行。想从源码安装或参与开发，见 [本地安装步骤](docs/local-install.md)。

## 对账

```sh
dsh-tally reconcile --bill ./bill.csv --format csv
```

把账本算出的金额和厂商账单按“天 × 模型”逐行对比，超出 1% 的差异会列出可能原因。详见 [`packages/tally` 的“对账”一节](packages/tally/README.md#对账)。

## 版本承诺

严格遵守 semver，接口只做加法。破坏性修改必须升主版本，旧主版本继续维护 6 个月。

## 安全扫描

下表由 [dsh-trust-check](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-trust-check) 扫描各包的构建产物生成（`pnpm trust:report`），测试会检查它是否过期。

<!-- trust-report:start -->
| 包 | 能力 | 红线 | 联网目标 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dsh-pricing-data` | fs-read | — | — |
| `dsh-tally-api` | — | — | — |
| `dsh-tally` | fs-read、fs-write | — | — |
| `dsh-tally-ui` | — | — | — |
| `dsh-tally-balance-deepseek` | credentials、network | creds-network | api.deepseek.com |
<!-- trust-report:end -->

**为什么 `dsh-tally-balance-deepseek` 有一条红线。** “读凭据加联网”是 dsh-trust-check 的红线组合。查询 DeepSeek 余额必须做这两件事，所以把它们单独放进这个小包里，其余四个包都不读凭据、不联网。这个包的源码一共约 300 行：

- 凭据只在 `src/index.ts` 中通过官方的 `ctx.credentials.resolve()` 读取，引用名默认是 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`，和官方 DeepSeek 适配器使用同一个，不另外保存 key；
- 联网只在 `src/fetchers.ts` 中请求 `https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`；
- 账号登录方式走官方的 `deepseekAccount` 服务，不接触 token；
- 所有错误信息都是固定文本，key 不会出现在错误、日志或缓存的余额结果里（有专门的测试）。

## 说明

所有金额都是**估算值，以厂商账单为准**。价格数据都附有官方来源链接和核对日期。2026-10-10 之前的请求显示为“未定价”，因为还没有核实过的历史价格。
